attest_leaf.description: Clerk/admin attests a registration leaf (dual L-reg half).

register.description: Participant self-register. `leaf_commit` required when gate is ClerkAttested.

start_ceremony.description: Start a ceremony (admin or future DAO proposal path).

anchor_policy.description: Optional anchor policy / root hint (opaque product string).

clerk.description: Clerk address allowed to AttestLeaf (defaults to admin).

membership_module.description: Voting / membership contract for DaoMember gate.

zk_cast_vote.description: Anonymous ballot: vote-sdk ZKP #2 proof + 11 x 32-byte public inputs. Any sender.

ballot.description: Opaque vote-share ciphertext for the election authority.

rvpk_sig.description: RedPallas SpendAuth signature by r_vpk over `ZkCastSighash`.

zk_execute.description: Passed proposals call dao-core `execute_proposal_hook`. Anyone may trigger.

zk_propose.description: Any member with voting power > 0. Opens round `zkp-<id>`.

ea_pk.description: Election authority key, 64 bytes (x || y, LE Pallas Fp).

zk_submit_tally.description: After expiration: totals attested by the election authority (or a tally proof).

definitions.name: cw_vote_ceremony_msg_RegistrationGate
definitions.description: How Register is gated for this session (configurable product policy).

clerk_attested.description: Register requires a clerk-attested leaf_commit (dregg / event-reg clerk).

dao_member.description: Register requires non-zero voting power on membership_module.

pre_propose.description: Hook site for pre-propose; not fully wired (rejects until implemented).

vm_proof.description: Dummy SA / wasmvm Authenticate stand-in (`vm_verifier` query VerifyMinHolders).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

any.description:
`CosmosMsg::Any` replaces the "stargate message" – a message wrapped
in a [protobuf Any](https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/proto3/#any)
that is supported by the chain. It behaves the same as
`CosmosMsg::Stargate` but has a better name and slightly improved syntax.

This is feature-gated at compile time with `cosmwasm_2_0` because
a chain running CosmWasm < 2.0 cannot process this.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_results_cosmos_msg_BankMsg
definitions.description:
The message types of the bank module.

See https://github.com/cosmos/cosmos-sdk/blob/v0.40.0/proto/cosmos/bank/v1beta1/tx.proto

burn.description:
This will burn the given coins from the contract's account.
There is no Cosmos SDK message that performs this, but it can be done by calling the bank keeper.
Important if a contract controls significant token supply that must be retired.

send.description:
Sends native tokens from the contract to the given address.

This is translated to a [MsgSend](https://github.com/cosmos/cosmos-sdk/blob/v0.40.0/proto/cosmos/bank/v1beta1/tx.proto#L19-L28).
`from_address` is automatically filled with the current contract's address.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256
cosmwasm_std_results_empty_Empty
definitions.description:
An empty struct that serves as a placeholder in different places,
such as contracts that don't set a custom message.

It is designed to be expressible in correct JSON and JSON Schema but
contains no meaningful data. Previously we used enums without cases,
but those cannot be represented as valid JSON Schema (https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/issues/451)

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_results_cosmos_msg_AnyMsg
definitions.description:
A message encoded the same way as a protobuf [Any](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/blob/master/src/google/protobuf/any.proto).
This is the same structure as messages in `TxBody` from [ADR-020](https://github.com/cosmos/cosmos-sdk/blob/master/docs/architecture/adr-020-protobuf-transaction-encoding.md)

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_results_cosmos_msg_WasmMsg
definitions.description:
The message types of the wasm module.

See https://github.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/blob/v0.14.0/x/wasm/internal/types/tx.proto

clear_admin.description:
Clears the admin on the given contract, so no more migration possible.
Fails if this contract is not currently admin of the target contract.

execute.description:
Dispatches a call to another contract at a known address (with known ABI).

This is translated to a [MsgExecuteContract](https://github.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/blob/v0.14.0/x/wasm/internal/types/tx.proto#L68-L78).
`sender` is automatically filled with the current contract's address.

msg.description: msg is the json-encoded ExecuteMsg struct (as raw Binary)

instantiate.description:
Instantiates a new contract from previously uploaded Wasm code.

The contract address is non-predictable. But it is guaranteed that
when emitting the same Instantiate message multiple times,
multiple instances on different addresses will be generated. See also
Instantiate2.

This is translated to a [MsgInstantiateContract](https://github.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/blob/v0.29.2/proto/cosmwasm/wasm/v1/tx.proto#L53-L71).
`sender` is automatically filled with the current contract's address.

label.description:
A human-readable label for the contract.

Valid values should:
- not be empty
- not be bigger than 128 bytes (or some chain-specific limit)
- not start / end with whitespace

msg.description: msg is the JSON-encoded InstantiateMsg struct (as raw Binary)

instantiate2.description:
Instantiates a new contract from previously uploaded Wasm code
using a predictable address derivation algorithm implemented in
[`cosmwasm_std::instantiate2_address`].

This is translated to a [MsgInstantiateContract2](https://github.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/blob/v0.29.2/proto/cosmwasm/wasm/v1/tx.proto#L73-L96).
`sender` is automatically filled with the current contract's address.
`fix_msg` is automatically set to false.

label.description:
A human-readable label for the contract.

Valid values should:
- not be empty
- not be bigger than 128 bytes (or some chain-specific limit)
- not start / end with whitespace

msg.description: msg is the JSON-encoded InstantiateMsg struct (as raw Binary)

migrate.description:
Migrates a given contract to use new wasm code. Passes a MigrateMsg to allow us to
customize behavior.

Only the contract admin (as defined in wasmd), if any, is able to make this call.

This is translated to a [MsgMigrateContract](https://github.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/blob/v0.14.0/x/wasm/internal/types/tx.proto#L86-L96).
`sender` is automatically filled with the current contract's address.

msg.description: msg is the json-encoded MigrateMsg struct that will be passed to the new code

new_code_id.description: the code_id of the new logic to place in the given contract

update_admin.description:
Sets a new admin (for migrate) on the given contract.
Fails if this contract is not currently admin of the target contract.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_hex_binary_HexBinary
definitions.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
